target_definition: Final FAIL or TIMED_OUT after configured retries/healing for the next logical execution; PASS is 0. Invalid business input correctly rejected by a passing test remains 0.
prediction_boundary: Before the target execution starts. Only executions ending strictly before prediction_time contribute to features.

failure_rate.definition: Fraction of prior logical executions with final FAIL/TIMED_OUT.

retry_rate.definition: Fraction of prior logical executions with additional attempts.

average_duration.definition: Mean summed attempt duration per prior logical execution; excludes waiting between retries.

duration_variance.definition: Population variance of those prior logical execution durations.

locator_failure_rate.definition: Fraction of prior executions with observed LOCATOR_NOT_FOUND/LOCATOR_AMBIGUOUS in any attempt or original_failure_type, including recovered symptoms.

actionability_failure_rate.definition: Fraction of prior executions with observed ACTIONABILITY_FAILURE in any attempt or original_failure_type.

healing_success_rate.definition: Final passing verified recoveries / prior executions attempting healing; null without prior opportunities.

knowledge_base_hit_rate.definition: Prior executions with a knowledge hit / prior learning-enabled executions attempting healing; null without prior opportunities.

risk_score.definition: Recomputed exclusively from the historical window: 100 * (0.60 * failure_rate + 0.25 * retry_rate + 0.15 * locator_failure_rate). Never reads an intelligence report.

failure_streak.definition: Consecutive failed executions at the end of the available historical window; capped at 10.

pass_streak.definition: Consecutive passing executions at the end of the available historical window; capped at 10.

duration_trend.definition: OLS slope of summed durations over the latest 5 completed executions, ms per execution.

duration_growth_rate.definition: (Mean duration of newer half - older half) / max(older mean, 1), using the latest 5 completed executions.

retry_trend.definition: OLS slope of binary retry indicators over the latest 5 completed executions.

locator_volatility_index.definition: Fraction of adjacent binary locator-symptom indicators changing within the latest 5 completed executions.

healing_reliance_score.definition: Fraction of the latest 5 completed executions attempting healing.

healing_success_momentum.definition: OLS slope of binary verified healing success over healing opportunities in the latest 5 executions; null with fewer than 2 opportunities.

mean_time_between_failures.definition: Mean elapsed milliseconds between final failure end times within the prior 10 executions; null with fewer than 2 failures.

recent_failure_rate.definition: Failure rate over the latest 5 completed executions.

limitations: Stability and risk are deterministic transformations of other requested features, not independent scientific signals.
Ordinary and controlled cohorts must be trained/evaluated separately. Current experiment/fault metadata are never predictors.
Rolling one-step evaluation may use earlier completed held-out outcomes as history; model parameters stay frozen.
Fixed mutation repetitions can make persistence trivial. Good controlled scores do not establish ordinary-regression prediction or unseen-fault generalization.
Progression uses isolated episode histories and later whole campaigns as holdout. Results establish controlled temporal-signal utility only, not natural regression generalization.
progression_history_policy: Campaign block ID is additionally included in progression series keys. Each episode starts a fresh history, including holdout episodes.
